blocks.prompt: 16 Find the general solution of the differential equation \((x^2 + xy + y^2)\,dx - x^2\,dy = 0\).
blocks.explanation:
\(x^2\), \(xy\), \(y^2\): teeno ki degree 2 hai aur \(x^2\) ki bhi 2, is liye equation homogeneous hai.
Diya kya hai? \((x^2 + xy + y^2)\,dx - x^2\,dy = 0\). Find kya karna hai? General solution.
Rule kaunsa? \(y = vx\); \(v\) cancel hone ke baad \(\frac{1}{1 + v^2}\) bachega jis ka integral \(\tan^{-1} v\) hai.
Is liye jawab mein inverse tangent aayega, ghabrane ki baat nahi.
Plan: \(\frac{dy}{dx}\) nikalna, \(y = vx\) rakhna, variables alag karna, integrate karna aur \(v = y/x\) wapas rakhna.
steps:
Diya gaya: \((x^2 + xy + y^2)\,dx - x^2\,dy = 0\).
Maloom karna: general solution.
Tareeqa: Homogeneous equation: \(y = vx\), \(\frac{dy}{dx} = v + x\frac{dv}{dx}\). Is se equation \(x\) aur \(v\) mein separable ho jayegi.

\(\frac{dy}{dx}\) likhein
\[\dfrac{dy}{dx} = \dfrac{x^2 + xy + y^2}{x^2}\]
\[= 1 + v + v^2\]
Kyun: \(x^2\,dy\) ko doosri taraf le ja kar \(x^2\,dx\) se divide kiya. Har term ko \(x^2\) se divide kiya: \(\frac{x^2}{x^2} = 1\), \(\frac{xy}{x^2} = \frac{y}{x} = v\), \(\frac{y^2}{x^2} = v^2\).

\(y = vx\) rakhein
\[v + x\dfrac{dv}{dx} = 1 + v + v^2\]
\[x\dfrac{dv}{dx} = 1 + v^2\]
Kyun: Dono taraf \(v\) tha, cancel ho gaya. Ab right side mein sirf \(v\) aur left mein \(x\frac{dv}{dx}\) hai, yani variables alag karna aasaan hai.

Variables alag kar ke integrate karein
\[\int \dfrac{dv}{1 + v^2} = \int \dfrac{dx}{x}\]
\[\tan^{-1} v = \ln|x| + \ln|C|\]
\[\tan^{-1} v = \ln|Cx|\]
Kyun: Standard result \(\frac{d}{dv}\tan^{-1} v = \frac{1}{1 + v^2}\) hai, is liye \(\int \frac{dv}{1 + v^2} = \tan^{-1} v\). Constant ko \(\ln|C|\) likha taa ke \(\ln|x| + \ln|C| = \ln|Cx|\) ban jaye.
Dhyan dein: \(\int \frac{dv}{1 + v^2}\) ko \(\ln(1 + v^2)\) likhna ghalat hai; log tab aata hai jab numerator denominator ka derivative ho, yahan numerator sirf 1 hai.

\(v = y/x\) wapas rakhein
\[\tan^{-1}\left(\dfrac{y}{x}\right) = \ln|Cx|\]
Kyun: Jawab asal variables \(x\) aur \(y\) mein hona chahiye.

Tasdeeq
Differentiate karein: \(\dfrac{1}{1 + y^2/x^2}\cdot\dfrac{xy' - y}{x^2} = \dfrac{1}{x}\), is liye
\[xy' - y = \dfrac{x^2 + y^2}{x}\]
\[x^2y' = x^2 + xy + y^2\]
Yeh di hui equation hai \(\checkmark\)
Kyun: \(\frac{1}{1 + y^2/x^2} = \frac{x^2}{x^2 + y^2}\); is ko simplify kar ke dono taraf \(x\) se multiply kiya to asal equation wapas aa gayi.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Answer key mein is sawal ka jawab number 18 par chhapa hai, 16 par nahi. Exercise 4.2 ki keys 2 se 29 tak hain jabke sawal sirf 25 hain (key 2 Question 1 ka jawab hai, aur keys 15, 19 aur 27 kisi chhape hue sawal ki nahi), is liye jawab 18 par dhoondiye, warna aap kisi aur sawal ka jawab dekh kar pareshan ho jayenge. Jawab khud, \(\tan^{-1}(y/x) = \ln|Cx|\), sahi hai.
